## Professional Summary

Hamed Mohamed is an Egyptian Full-Stack Engineer and Computer Engineering graduate (GPA 3.5/4.0) based in Turkey with production experience building secure, scalable, and high-performance web systems. He shipped a high-throughput QR attendance platform serving 2,000+ users across 6 faculties (~300 DAU, reducing latency by 98%), and architected a production multilingual platform for a 28-year-old Istanbul restaurant serving ~100 daily visitors with Next.js 16, Supabase, 10 languages, and Schema.org Local SEO. He is an active contributor to the NodeSecure open-source ecosystem with 7 merged pull requests covering AST security analysis, SSRF detection, and performance benchmarking.

**Availability**: Computer Engineering graduate available immediately for full-time remote/on-site positions and freelance projects. Fully open to relocation (Saudi Arabia preferred).

## Professional Experience

### Full-Stack Engineer & Security Researcher
**AI & Digital Transformation Unit** — Tokat Gaziosmanpaşa University, Turkey
**Period**: April 2025 – Present (Hybrid: On-site & Remote)

This is a professional engineering role during Hamed's academic tenure at the university. Key achievements:

1. **Team Leadership**: Led a 3-person engineering team to architect and deploy a QR-based attendance ecosystem currently utilized by 2,000+ users across 6 faculties, under final review for university-wide official adoption.

2. **Performance Engineering**: Engineered a hybrid QR verification pipeline (JWT / Remote / Temporary fallback) with dynamic server-side resource allocation. Achieved:
   - 98% latency reduction (from 94.91ms to 1.53ms)
   - +6,100% throughput boost (up to 653 requests/second)

3. **System Resilience**: Implemented the Circuit Breaker pattern (Opossum) to ensure 99.9% service availability and automated fallback mechanisms during peak traffic periods.

4. **Data Optimization**: Developed high-performance ingestion scripts capable of processing 25,000+ records in <1.5 seconds, automating previously manual workflows and improving data integrity.

5. **Testing & Security**: Wrote comprehensive unit and integration tests covering core verification flows, failure scenarios, and edge cases. Achieved ~85% backend test coverage and integrated SAST/DAST into CI/CD, catching and fixing 15+ vulnerabilities before production.

### Freelance Full-Stack Developer
**Kardeşler Kebap & Cafe Cihangir** — Istanbul, Turkey
**Period**: 2026 (Completed & Delivered)

Architected and deployed a complete digital restaurant platform for a 28-year-old Turkish restaurant in Cihangir, Istanbul:
1. **Full-Stack Architecture**: Replaced legacy, slow WordPress site with a high-performance Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, and Supabase platform.
2. **Internationalization**: Implemented 10-language dynamic routing (Turkish, English, Arabic, Russian, French, Persian, German, Italian, Spanish, Chinese) with full hreflang coverage.
3. **Live Currency & Dynamic Pricing**: Built real-time currency conversion for 6 currencies (TRY, USD, EUR, GBP, RUB, SAR) and dynamic multi-currency pricing across the entire menu.
4. **Ordering & Admin**: WhatsApp direct ordering with localized message templates, plus a custom owner admin panel for non-technical price updates without code.
5. **SEO & WordPress Migration**: Executed full WordPress migration with 25+ 301 permanent redirect rules (0 ranking loss) and implemented Schema.org (Restaurant, Menu, ImageGallery, BreadcrumbList) Local SEO. Serves ~100 real daily visitors.

---

## Open Source Contributions — NodeSecure Ecosystem

Hamed contributed 7 merged pull requests to the NodeSecure project (js-x-ray & scanner) in Q1 2026, improving open-source security tooling:

1. **PR #456**: Introduced the sensitivity option (conservative/aggressive) across AstAnalyser, ProbeRunner, and SourceFile — enabling configurable detection depth without breaking backward compatibility.

2. **PR #452**: Built the insecure-random probe that flags unsafe Math.random() usage.

3. **PR #462**: Improved localhost/SSRF detection in the shady-url checker.

4. **PR #467**: Added the Named Main Handlers pattern to isSerializeEnv, allowing probes to handle multiple validation scenarios; added direct process.env detection in aggressive mode.

5. **PR #468**: Implemented email literal collection using CollectableSet API in the isLiteral probe, with 5 comprehensive test cases.

6. **PR #496**: Built benchmarking infrastructure using mitata to track AST analysis performance baselines across releases.

## Key Projects

### 1. QR Attendance System (2025–Present)
**Role**: Lead Developer & Architect
**Stack**: Node.js, Express.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, React.js, Prisma ORM

A production QR-based attendance ecosystem serving 2,000+ users across 6 faculties at Tokat Gaziosmanpaşa University:
- Hybrid verification pipeline (JWT / Remote / Temporary fallback)
- 98% latency reduction (94.91ms → 1.53ms)
- +6,100% throughput improvement (up to 653 req/s)
- 99.9% uptime via Circuit Breaker pattern
- ~85% test coverage with SAST/DAST in CI/CD
- Under review for university-wide official adoption

### 2. Kardeşler Cihangir Restaurant Platform (2026)
**Role**: Lead Full-Stack Developer & SEO Architect
**Stack**: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, Supabase, Schema.org
**Live URL**: https://www.kardeslercihangir.com (Developer Credit: /tasarim-gelistirme)

A production digital restaurant platform serving ~100 daily visitors for an Istanbul restaurant operating since 1998:
- 10 languages live with dynamic routing and hreflang
- Live currency converter for 6 currencies
- Direct WhatsApp ordering flow with automated localized message templates
- Non-technical owner admin panel for real-time price updates
- Zero-loss WordPress migration with 25+ 301 redirects & Schema.org Local SEO

### 3. DragonSploit (2025)
**Role**: Lead Developer
**Stack**: Node.js, AI/ML integration, Security scanning

An AI-powered vulnerability scanning platform:
- Intent-based orchestration engine that dynamically selects scan strategies — estimated 40% efficiency gain over static queue-based approaches
- Context-aware stack-detection module (WordPress, Nginx) to run targeted vulnerability tests, reducing false-positive alert rate by an estimated 70%

### 4. Portfolio Website — hamedmohamed.dev (2025–Present)
**Stack**: Next.js 16, TypeScript, Framer Motion, Tailwind CSS

A modern, internationalized (EN/AR/TR) portfolio website featuring:
- Server-side rendering for SEO optimization
- Custom animations and micro-interactions
- RTL support for Arabic content
- Contact form with API endpoint

### 5. Sila Islamic App (2026)
**Role**: Lead Developer
**Stack**: Flutter, Dart, Riverpod, Firebase, Isar Database, AI Speech-to-Text

A comprehensive Islamic mobile application featuring:
- Accurate prayer times with automatic Adhan based on GPS
- Full Quran reader with interactive Hifz (memorization) shadow method
- AI-powered Tasmi (recitation verification) using Speech-to-Text technology
- Daily Azkar and Ibadah (worship) tracking system

### From Computer Repair to Software Engineering
**Published**: October 2026
**Links**:
- English: https://www.hamedmohamed.dev/en/blog/from-computer-repair-to-software-engineering
- Arabic: https://www.hamedmohamed.dev/ar/blog/from-computer-repair-to-software-engineering

**Overview**:
Hamed Mohamed's technical journey detailing his transition from troubleshooting hardware circuits and disassembling computers at age 12 (earning his Mini Maintenance Hardware & Software certificate in 2015), diving into web standards and digital systems in 2019–2020, to graduating with honors in Computer Engineering from Tokat Gaziosmanpaşa University (3.5/4.0 GPA). The article explains how first-principles mathematical rigor, operating systems knowledge, and relentless curiosity shaped his engineering approach to building resilient architectures: from reducing QR attendance API latency by 98% for 2,000+ users to contributing AST security probes to the NodeSecure open-source ecosystem.
